title: Concept: Deprecated key-derivation cipher in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, crypto.createCipher is used. Node.js marks it deprecated because it derives key material from a password with an outdated routine and offers no control over the IV, so the same password can produce repeated keystreams. Modern review expects an explicit KDF and an authenticated mode.
applicability: javascript services that encrypt configuration values or user data.
risk: Weak key derivation and keystream reuse; MEDIUM severity.
